# WMS / WMTS layer audit

<!-- Generated by `node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs --write=WMS_WMTS_LAYER_AUDIT.md` —
     do not edit the tables by hand; re-run the tool after changing a layer. -->

Every raster service the map can draw — the CENAGIS / IH PAN historical catalogue,
the eHarta historics, the Copernicus VHR mosaics, the country LiDAR/relief services
(Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, England, France, Denmark, Sweden)
and the vegetation-phenology WMTS — is defined once in `js/layer-registry.js` and
guarded by `js/wms-health.js`. This file is the offline check of that statement:
the tool rebuilds each layer's real request with the very same code the map uses
and verifies it against the service's documented contract.

## Why it exists

On **2026-10-13** every `GetMap` of the CENAGIS / IH PAN GeoServer answered
**HTTP 200 with a Java exception body** instead of an image:

```
java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to create a valid ImageInputStream for the
provided input: /opt/geoserver/data_dir/cartomatic/UKvME/mosaick/
ukvme_3857_transparent.ecw
```

A browser cannot decode that as an image, so Leaflet fired `tileerror` for every
tile and left the layer blank — silently. The user-visible summary of that class of
failure is what this audit is about: **a third-party raster server that answers
“200 OK” with something that is not a tile**.

## The three errors that started this audit

| what was seen | registry entry | service + LAYERS | root cause | whose fault |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| the Central Europe row (“Central Europe Map 1:300k”) reported as not loadable — the guard's *“This map cannot be loaded”* notice | `premium.mitteleuropa` (2D) / `cenagis.ukvme` (3D) | `pastmaps.cenagis.edu.pl`, `ihpan:ukvme_3857` | HTTP 200 with `java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to create a valid ImageInputStream … ukvme_3857_transparent.ecw` — the GeoServer cannot read the ECW raster behind the mosaic | CENAGIS / IH PAN (external) |
| the German Empire row (“German Empire Map 1:100k”) reported as not loadable — same notice | `premium.kdr-100k` (2D) / `cenagis.kdr` (3D) | same server, `ihpan:kdr_3857` | the same failure class: a 200 response that is not an image | CENAGIS / IH PAN (external) |
| *“Invalid or missing Dataforsyningen token”* | `lidar.dk-dhm` | `/api/geo/dk-dhm` → Dataforsyningen DHM | the deployment has no `DATAFORSYNINGEN_TOKEN` (or a visitor-supplied token was rejected); the proxy answers 401 `{"error":"dataforsyningen_token_missing"}` | deployment config (this repo) + the token holder |

The first two shared one root cause: **the sheet's Web-Mercator mosaic is unreadable inside the
operator's GeoServer** — the endpoint is correct, the service answers 200, its own body is broken.
They are no longer broken for the user because the rows were **repointed** to the readable twin of
the same sheet (§CENAGIS repoint below, 2026-10-15); the guard stays in place for the next
outage. The third one is a configuration gap and is reported as such.

## The CENAGIS repoint (2026-10-15)

CENAGIS publishes most sheets once per CRS (`…_3857`, `…_2180`, `…_4326`). Two of the
Web-Mercator mosaics cannot be read by the operator's GeoServer at all — not a network, CORS or
naming problem, and nothing this repo can fix: every `GetMap` for them is answered with
**HTTP 200 and a Java exception body**, so the browser gets no pixel and the guard reports the
row. The **same sheets are readable in the `…_2180` twin**, so the two rows now ask for that one:

| row | was (unreadable) | now (readable) | 2D request | 3D request |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cenagis.ukvme` (3D) + `premium.mitteleuropa` (2D) | `ihpan:ukvme_3857` | `ihpan:ukvme_2180` | EPSG:3857 GetMap, re-projected by the GeoServer | EPSG:2180 GetMap through the tile proxy |
| `cenagis.kdr` (3D) + `premium.kdr-100k` (2D) | `ihpan:kdr_3857` | `ihpan:kdr_2180` | EPSG:3857 GetMap, re-projected by the GeoServer | EPSG:2180 GetMap through the tile proxy |

How the twins were verified (browser-free, 2026-10-15) — `GetMap` **and** `GetFeatureInfo` at
Warsaw, Poznań and Berlin, for both request CRSes:

* `ihpan:ukvme_3857` → `Unable to create a valid ImageInputStream … ukvme_3857_transparent.ecw`;
  `ihpan:ukvme_2180_transparent` does not exist; `ihpan:ukvme_2180` → PNG + opaque pixels
  (`RED 38 / GREEN 7 / BLUE 22 / ALPHA 255` at Warsaw, `179/163/182/255` at Berlin).
* `ihpan:kdr_3857` → the same exception for `kdr_3857_transparent.ecw`; `ihpan:kdr_2180` → PNG +
  opaque pixels (`33/32/21/255` at Poznań, `199/203/182/253` at Berlin).
* Both twins answer correctly to a `1.1.1`/`SRS=EPSG:3857` request (the 2D path) *and* to a
  `1.3.0`/`CRS=EPSG:2180` request with a PL-1992 bbox (the 3D proxy path).

If the operator ever repairs the Web-Mercator ECWs, the rows may go back to the `…_3857` twins —
until then **they must not**, and `W_DEAD_MOSAIC` (below) fails the audit if one of them does.

## What is checked

* **WMS** — https endpoint, `LAYERS` present, version/CRS pair (`1.3.0` → `CRS`,
  `1.1.1` → `SRS`), axis order for EPSG:4326, `FORMAT` vs `TRANSPARENT`
  (JPEG cannot carry transparency), usable raster format.
* **WMTS** — `SERVICE/REQUEST/VERSION/LAYER/STYLE/FORMAT/TILEMATRIXSET/TILEMATRIX/
  TILEROW/TILECOL` present, a `TIME` value for time-aware layers, a
  `maxNativeZoom` matching the published pyramid.
* **Module-built layers** (`kind: dynamic`) — the builder named by the registry
  exists, loads and returns a concrete URL for a real tile, carrying the KVP the
  service needs.
* **Routing** — a host documented as “no CORS” must go through the same-origin proxy
  in 3D, and a same-origin endpoint must not.
* **Availability guard** — every third-party endpoint must be watched by
  `js/wms-health.js`: `probe` (one GetMap before a layer is added, WMS factory).
  or `watch` (adopted from the live map, tripped by a run of failed tiles).

### Small print

Things the tables above cannot show, verified in the code:

* **The unused generic WMTS branch.** `js/map-app.js` still has a
  `cfg.type === 'wms_kvp'` branch that asks for `tilematrixset=default028mm`;
  **no registry entry uses it today** (the country LiDAR layers are `wms`, `xyz` or
  module-built). If a layer is ever moved onto it, the tile-matrix set must become
  `EPSG:3857` with `EPSG:3857:{z}` matrix names (exactly what the `vegfp` builders
  send), or the service answers a `ServiceException` about an unknown TileMatrixSet.
* **Native-CRS sheets.** `cenagis.kdr`, `cenagis.ukvme`, `cenagis.city_warszawa_1822`, `cenagis.city_praga_1796` are served in EPSG:2180 — `cenagis.kdr`/`premium.kdr-100k` and `cenagis.ukvme`/`premium.mitteleuropa` because their `_3857` twin is unreadable (§CENAGIS repoint): the 2D map
  always asks EPSG:3857 (GeoServer reprojects on the fly) and the 3D view goes through
  the same-origin proxy, which asks the server in the sheet's own CRS.
* **Coverage vs `bounds`.** `vegfp.ppi` declares Romanian `bounds` while the WMTS
  covers Europe. `bounds` is a UI hint (it clips the 2D layer and widens on `.eu`); what
  limits the actual requests is the layer's own footprint mask (`VegFpTileLayer`), which
  returns `L.Util.emptyImageUrl` for a tile outside the polygon — a guarded layer must
  still be assumed to answer anything inside its published pyramid.
* **`HOSTS` is not a safety net by itself.** Adding a host only means “watch this”; the
  guard never rewrites a request, so a service that is up but serving the wrong thing
  (a cached mosaic from the wrong year, say) is out of its reach by design.

## Findings

None — every checked invariant holds.
## What a failure looks like, per provider

| provider (host) | the request the app sends | typical failure (`curl -I` will show it) | owner | what the app does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CENAGIS / IH PAN** (`pastmaps.cenagis.edu.pl`) | WMS GetMap (1.3.0 for the catalogue, 1.1.1 for the premium rows) | 200 + a Java exception body: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to create a valid ImageInputStream (cartomatic/*/mosaick/*_3857_transparent.ecw — ukvme, kdr, …); occasionally 502/504 from the host. The *…_2180* twin of the same sheet still renders — see §CENAGIS repoint | external (the operator's GeoServer / raster store) | probe runs before the layer is added; on failure the row is switched off, marked and the notice names the provider, with Retry |
| **geo-spatial.org (eHarta)** (`services.geo-spatial.org`) | WMS GetMap, version 1.1.0 (SRS=) | 200 + ServiceExceptionReport XML, or an empty tile where the mosaic has no coverage | external | probe before the layer is added, same notice path |
| **Copernicus Land / EEA discomap** (`copernicus.discomap.eea.europa.eu`) | ArcGIS MapServer/WMSServer GetMap, WMS 1.1.1, JPEG (transparent=false) | 200 + an ArcGIS JSON error, or a blank JPEG outside the VHR footprint of that year | external | probe; the 3D view always goes through the same-origin proxy because the host sends no CORS headers |
| **Copernicus Land / EEA discomap** (`image.discomap.eea.europa.eu`) | ArcGIS ImageServer/WMSServer GetMap, WMS 1.1.1, JPEG | 200 + an ArcGIS JSON error, or a blank JPEG where the LAEA-native mosaic has no data | external | probe; 3D through the proxy for the same reason |
| **Danmarks Miljøportal** (`arealeditering-dist-geo.miljoeportal.dk`) | WMS 1.3.0 GetMap (CRS=EPSG:3857, uppercase KVP), dai:bes_naturtyper, PNG + transparent | 200 + ServiceExceptionReport XML (GeoServer answers exceptions with 200), or an all-alpha tile where the layer has no polygons. The capabilities advertise only EPSG:25832/CRS:84 while GetMap serves 3857 normally — judge by the tile, not by the capabilities | external (the agency GeoServer) | no guard row: js/danish-layers.js owns the switch and prints its own status line (the layer opts out with _detectlabNoGuard); the host is still named in js/wms-health.js HOSTS so a tile-error burst can be attributed |
| **Slots- og Kulturstyrelsen (Fund og Fortidsminder)** (`www.kulturarv.dk`) | WMS 1.3.0 GetMap (CRS=EPSG:3857, uppercase KVP), fundogfortidsminder_punkt_fredet / _punkt_ikkefredet, PNG + transparent | 200 + ServiceExceptionReport XML (GeoServer answers exceptions with 200) or an all-alpha tile. The capabilities advertise EPSG:25832 and CRS:84 while GetMap serves EPSG:3857 normally (verified 2026-10-19) — judge by the tile, not by the capabilities. A renamed layer answers "Could not find layer …" the same way | external (the agency GeoServer) | no guard row: js/danish-layers.js owns the switch and prints its own status line (the layers opt out with _detectlabNoGuard); the host is still named in js/wms-health.js HOSTS so a tile-error burst can be attributed |
| **ASIG / geoportal.asig.gov.al** (`geoportal.asig.gov.al`) | WMS 1.3.0 GetMap (CRS=EPSG:3857, STYLES=) for the nine exact Names: Topografike:50K_Topografike, Orthophoto:Ortofoto_1999, orthophoto_2015:OrthoImagery_20cm, DSM:Dsm_Hill_Group, Dtm_2015:Hillshade_2015_group, iktk:zonatembrojturatetrashegimisekulturore22_07_2026, akzm:zonat_mbrojtura_081124, iktk:zonatembrojturatetrashegimisekulturore_pike13_05_2026, akzm:monumentet_natyrore_07032023 | HTTP 200 with XML/HTML or a body that is not a decodable image is a tile error; the same-origin production probe separately requires HTTP 200, image/*, at least 32 bytes, no exception body and no X-Map3D-Upstream failure marker. EPSG:3857 is retained as the request path but is not listed literally in the owner-supplied capabilities excerpt (which advertises EPSG:900913). | external (the agency GeoServer; government host, no SLA) | rows are rendered individually in the existing Historical Maps, Satellite, LiDAR and Heritage Sites sections; renderer owns error handling, retries EPSG:4326 after the configured EPSG:3857 error burst, then reports a persistent fallback failure on that layer row |
| **SYKE / Finnish Environment Institute** (`paikkatiedot.ymparisto.fi`) | GeoServer WMS/WFS for Finnish protected-site layers | HTTP 200 ServiceException XML/HTML, a WFS JSON exception, or an empty image outside coverage | external (SYKE) | self-guarded Finland row reports failed tiles and retries through the Finland proxy |
| **Ålands landskapsregering** (`kartor.regeringen.ax`) | ArcGIS REST export / query for Åland heritage layers | HTTP 200 JSON error or an image response without usable map pixels | external (Åland) | self-guarded Finland row reports failed tiles and retries through the Finland proxy |
| **Maanmittauslaitos** (`karttamoottori.maanmittauslaitos.fi`) | ETRS-TM35FIN WMTS REST tile | HTTP 403/5xx or an XML/HTML access/error page instead of a tile | external (MML) | self-guarded Finland row reports failed tiles and uses the configured same-origin fallback |
| **Museovirasto / Museoverkko** (`kartta.museoverkko.fi`) | WMTS GetLayerTile or WFS endpoint | HTTP 200 JSON error (including a problematic-response message) or XML/HTML in place of an image | external (Museovirasto) | self-guarded Finland row displays its error status and retries |
| **Maanmittauslaitos / kiinteistötietojen karttapalvelu** (`hkp.maanmittauslaitos.fi`) | Finnish cadastral MVT/WMTS tile endpoint | HTTP 403/5xx, malformed vector tile, or an HTML/JSON body instead of a tile | external (MML) | self-guarded Finland row reports tile failures |
| **DetectLab hosted Finnish layer data (Supabase)** (`dacboefvooxgsngxkavx.supabase.co`) | Static GeoJSON object from the project storage bucket | HTTP 404/5xx or a JSON error body in place of the configured data object | DetectLab deployment and storage configuration | self-guarded Finland data rows surface load errors |
| **IGN France / Géoplateforme** (`data.geopf.fr`) | WMS 1.3.0 GetMap (CRS=EPSG:3857), IGNF_LIDAR-HD_* | 200 + ServiceExceptionReport XML, or 400 for an unknown LAYERS/CRS pair | external | probe before the layer is added |
| **swisstopo** (`wmts.geo.admin.ch`) | WMTS KVP GetTile (ch.swisstopo.swisssurface3d-relief) | 200 + WMTS ServiceException XML, or swisstopo's standard no-data tile beyond the modelled area | external | adopted by the guard when it goes on the map, then watched: three failed tiles in a row remove the layer and explain the provider (no probe — the host publishes dozens of products) |
| **Environment Agency (England)** (`environment.data.gov.uk`) | WMTS KVP GetTile, TILEMATRIXSET=WebMercatorQuad | 200 + XML ServiceException for a tile outside the published limits | external | adopted and watched for tile errors; the module itself clips its bounds and asks for transparent tiles past maxNativeZoom |
| **Kartverket (høydedata.no)** (`hoydedata.no`) | ArcGIS exportImage (image/png, bbox per tile) | 200 + a JSON error when the product has no coverage at that scale | external | adopted and watched; the module paints a blank tile for a failed fetch and reports it through DetectLabWmsHealth.noteFailure(), so a run of them still switches the row off and explains itself |
| **AHN / Esri Nederland** (`ahn.arcgisonline.nl`) | ArcGIS exportImage (image/png) | 200 + a JSON error, or 404 on a retired service version | external | adopted and watched; the module paints a blank tile and warns once in the console, and reports each failure through DetectLabWmsHealth.noteFailure() |
| **GUGiK / geoportal.gov.pl** (`mapy.geoportal.gov.pl`) | WMS 1.3.0 GetMap (CRS=EPSG:3857), Raster | 200 + ServiceExceptionReport XML; during maintenance the host answers an HTML page instead | external | adopted and watched for tile errors |
| **IGN España / IDEE** (`wms-mapa-lidar.idee.es`) | WMS 1.1.1 GetMap (SRS=EPSG:3857), EL.GridCoverage | 200 + a MapServer text error for an unknown LAYERS, or a fully transparent tile off the LiDAR footprint | external | adopted and watched; 3D can be re-pointed with window.SPAIN_LIDAR_PROXY_URL |
| **VITO / Copernicus HR-VPP** (`phenology.hrvpp2.vgt.vito.be`) | WMTS KVP GetTile + TIME (dekadal for PPI, annual for VPP) | 200 + ServiceException XML for an out-of-range TIME or a zoom level the cache does not hold | external | adopted and watched; the layer's own footprint mask stops most out-of-footprint requests before they are sent |
| **CAST / University of Arkansas (CORONA)** (`geoserve.cast.uark.edu`) | WMS GetMap with tiled=true (GeoWebCache), LAYER corona:<product> | 200 + GeoWebCache XML when that pass has no cached mosaic | external | adopted in watch-only mode: one layer per pass, so a single failed pass must not switch the row off |
| **Dataforsyningen (Denmark), via the same-origin proxy** (`/api/geo/dk-dhm`) | the proxy builds the Dataforsyningen GetMap and adds the token server-side | 401 {"error":"dataforsyningen_token_missing"} when the deployment has no DATAFORSYNINGEN_TOKEN; 401/403 + token XML from Dataforsyningen itself when the token is invalid | this repo's deployment (env var) + external service | module shows the deployment-specific notice and switches the row off |
| **Lantmäteriet (Sweden), via the same-origin proxy** (`/api/geo/se-hojdmodell`) | the proxy adds the Geotorget credentials server-side | 401 {"error":"lantmateriet_credentials_missing"} when no LANTMATERIET_WMS_* env is set | this repo's deployment (env vars) + external service | module shows the Geotorget credentials notice |

Every one of these arrives as **HTTP 200**: the failure is in the body, which is exactly why the browser cannot report it and why the guard has to.

## Deployment requirements (server side)

| variable | where | needed by | if it is missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATAFORSYNINGEN_TOKEN` | Netlify env / `backend/.env` | Denmark LiDAR proxy (`netlify/functions/dk-dhm.mjs`, `backend/src/routes/geoProxy.js`) | proxy answers 401 `dataforsyningen_token_missing`; the row shows the “not configured on this deployment” notice instead of staying blank |
| `LANTMATERIET_WMS_TOKEN` (or `LANTMATERIET_WMS_USER` + `LANTMATERIET_WMS_PASSWORD`) | same | Sweden LiDAR proxy `/api/geo/se-hojdmodell` | 401 `lantmateriet_credentials_missing`; the row shows the Geotorget credentials notice |
| `window.DETECTLAB_CENAGIS_WMS` | page (optional) | re-points the whole CENAGIS catalogue at a mirror without a code change | the app keeps using `pastmaps.cenagis.edu.pl` |
| `window.SPAIN_LIDAR_PROXY_URL`, `window.EA_LIDAR_PROXY_HOST`, `window.DETECTLAB_DK_TOKEN`, `window.DETECTLAB_SE_WMS_SOURCE` | page (optional) | per-country mirrors / client tokens for deployments without a backend | the app uses the direct endpoint or the same-origin proxy |
| `window.DETECTLAB_MAP3D.terrain` | page (optional) | the 3D terrain provider/key (`maptiler`) — never committed | the 3D view falls back to the keyless provider |

## Re-checking

```bash
node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs                 # table + findings, exits non-zero on an error
node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs --urls          # just the sample URLs (one per line)
node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs --json          # machine-readable, for CI
node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs --layer=cenagis.ukvme --tile=12/2345/1480
node tools/audit-wms-layers.mjs --write=WMS_WMTS_LAYER_AUDIT.md   # regenerate this file
```

The tool never talks to the network: it checks the requests the app *would* send.
Live results are deliberately separate. Albania requires the same-origin proxy probe:
`node tools/probe-asig-production.mjs --origin=https://detectlab.eu --tile=12/2273/1530`.
No live production result is implied by this offline audit.

## What to do when one of them breaks

* **The guard already said it** — the layer is switched off, its row is dimmed and
  the notice names the provider. Nothing to do but wait for the operator.
* **Re-point the catalogue** — CENAGIS layers can be moved to a mirror or a cached
  copy without touching the code: set `window.DETECTLAB_CENAGIS_WMS` before
  `js/layer-registry.js` loads. The guard watches the mirror host as well.
* **A host that is not in the guard yet** — add it to `HOSTS` in `js/wms-health.js`
  with the provider name to show; the map hook adopts its layers automatically.
* **A configuration error, not an outage** — report it with
  `DetectLabWmsHealth.markUnavailable(layer, message)` so the row is switched off
  with its own explanation (that is what the Denmark token path does).
